description: An invariant whose pure `fn` reads a file-scope `let` that a `function` writes: E-DECL-INVARIANT-IMPURE.
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md-S483-struct-invariant-syntax ("yes, your recommendations on all three plus the follow-up"); ruling:user-voice-scrml.md-S482-struct-invariant-contract ("RULED yes (a)")
rationale: §66.13.5 rule 7 (r1): the outer bindings an invariant may not read directly, it may not read through a `fn` either.
